Scope: /api/meta must report a build identity that tracks redeploys, plus a human-authorised second item (upgrade trigger on the boilerplate.py ponytail marker, and a false ponytail-marker count in a TODO debt row). The row was blocked as (dashboard) on a false premise: the 2026-08-17 console check found no sha to borrow because ZEABUR_GIT_COMMIT_SHA is BUILD-phase only. So it became a repo change (zbpack build_command writes BUILD_SHA, gitignored; a fastapi-free build_id.py resolves it) and needed no dashboard access. S2 s own validation gate is UNRUN and unrunnable from here - no agent can run a Zeabur build - and clears by curling the live instance across TWO redeploys, since the sha must MOVE, not merely exist. Round 1 (1H/4M/4L): the HIGH was an unvalidated GIT_SHA branch rendering latest/main/an unexpanded $ZEABUR_GIT_COMMIT_SHA as build labels while the ADR claimed validation at every step; three MEDIUM were documents of record contradicting the tree (a GIT_DIR leak claimed closed but open on the production path, 16-vs-18 failures against the artifact cited as its own evidence, a precedence table published as enforced while a git-first resolver stayed green at 0 failures). Round 2 (0H/3M/3L): 8 of 9 closed, R4 RELOCATED - the new _temp_repo precedence assertions went silently vacuous under an absolute GIT_INDEX_FILE, i.e. exactly the linked-worktree condition this PR was authored in, so the falsifier was dead where the gate runs; and R10 was a false RED the round-1 repair introduced. Round 3: APPROVED, both falsifiers measured live again (M6=2 under GIT_INDEX_FILE, M11=1) and M8 STRENGTHENED to 3 under an ambient GIT_DIR rather than weakened. All 14 mutation counts independently reproduced.
